gen_risks.description: Inadequate stakeholder engagement may lead to ineffective project implementation
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a stakeholder engagement plan to ensure active participation and feedback

gen_risks.description: Financial management risks may lead to inefficient use of project funds
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement robust financial management systems and conduct regular audits

gen_risks.description: Procurement risks may lead to delays or inefficiencies in project implementation
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive procurement plan and conduct regular monitoring

gen_risks.description: Environmental and social risks may lead to negative impacts on local communities
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct thorough environmental and social impact assessments and develop mitigation measures

gen_risks.description: Inadequate capacity for health emergency response may lead to ineffective response to outbreaks
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and implement a comprehensive health emergency response plan

gen_risks.description: Inadequate laboratory capacity may lead to delays in disease diagnosis and response
gen_risks.mitigation: Strengthen laboratory capacity through training, equipment, and infrastructure upgrades

gen_risks.description: Inadequate surveillance systems may lead to delayed detection of outbreaks
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and implement effective surveillance systems, including event-based and community-based surveillance

gen_risks.description: Inadequate risk communication and community engagement may lead to ineffective response to outbreaks
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and implement effective risk communication and community engagement strategies

gen_risks.description: Inadequate gender considerations may lead to ineffective response to outbreaks, particularly for vulnerable populations
gen_risks.mitigation: Integrate gender considerations into project design and implementation

gen_risks.description: Inadequate climate change considerations may lead to ineffective response to outbreaks, particularly in vulnerable areas
gen_risks.mitigation: Integrate climate change considerations into project design and implementation
gen_risks.evidence: Section C. Relevance to Higher Level Objectives

gt_risks.description: Political and governance risk (Moderate), considering fragility, socio-political instability, violence and weak governance of beneficiary countries.
gt_risks.mitigation: Close engagement by the World Bank to coordinate activities with other key partners.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk (Substantial), considering the complexities of coordinating national-level and regional-level activities to align and build on each other, and the different levels of readiness at country-level.
gt_risks.mitigation: Exploring the possibility of a coordinated implementation arrangement with CEMAC as the lead technical coordination body for regional activities.

gt_risks.description: Weak institutional capacity for implementation and sustainability (Substantial), combined with overstretched or nonexistent PIUs in respective countries.
gt_risks.mitigation: Strengthening the existing PIUs and intensive capacity building and targeted TA for newly established PIUs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risk (Substantial) due to weak governance structures and inadequate FM systems.
gt_risks.mitigation: Close implementation support by the World Bank, including TA as well as additional training and coaching on fiduciary processes.

gt_risks.description: E&S risk (Substantial) given the security risks associated with service delivery in FCV (fragility, conflict, and violence) settings.
gt_risks.mitigation: Close implementation support by the World Bank, including TA as well as additional training and coaching on managing E&S risks.
